lane: Titan lag-free lane/titan-lagfree-20261014, package P7 step 2(a)
captain_ruling: Tempo half-time lock: MUST be fixed to a standard that guarantees it works — see the gate in P7. Treat any gate failure as no-ship.
captain_pass_criteria_verbatim: reported BPM within ±4 % of the annotated level (±2 % on synthetic cases);
re-acquire within 2 beats after a tempo step;
low confidence (never a false lock) on the drumless and silence cases.
captain_rule: The gate is never widened. Adding corpus tracks re-freezes it.
scope: Synthetic suite (a) only. The real corpus (b) is a proposal, not part of this freeze.
suite_pass_rule: 100 % of cases pass every applicable criterion. Any failing case is a gate failure (no-ship).

definitions.update: one TempoTrackerEvent with updated=true (every 3rd 7.5 ms AP frame, 44.44 Hz); t_s is the end of the analysed 24 kHz hop in input time
definitions.asserting: locked or confidence >= 0.3 (renderer tempo gate floor, inhouse_waveform.cpp:347 clamp01((c-0.30)/0.30))
definitions.truth(u): 60 / interval of the annotated beats holding u (kick/backbeat level; first and last interval extended outward)
definitions.P: annotated beat period at the start of the judged segment
definitions.grace_meaning: acquire: case start and music after a silence gap (lock within 4 beats); step: first segment after a tempo step (re-acquire within 2 beats); release: a silence gap may keep asserting for 2 beats of the preceding tempo; none_from_start: pad and lead-in, no grace

criteria.LOCK: every update in [a + G*P, b) of every tempo segment is locked and correct (locked within 4 beats / re-acquired within 2 beats, and held to the end of the segment)
criteria.BPM: every asserting update in [a + G*P, b) of every tempo segment is correct
criteria.FLIP: zero locked updates anywhere in a tempo segment at a metrical relative (within tol) that are not correct; exempt only: a step segment's grace window while bpm equals the previous segment's truth within tol (hold-over)
criteria.LOWCONF: no asserting update in [a + G, b) of any none segment (drumless pad, lead-in, silence gap)

reported_not_gating.acquired_beats: start of the final run of locked+correct updates, in beats from the segment start
reported_not_gating.phase_ms: beat_tick update instants against the nearest annotated beat (median and p95 |error|). The P7 defaults name phase +-25 ms; the P7 pass list does not. Adding it as a criterion is a narrowing re-freeze (RULING NEEDED).

input_chain: p7_synth.py 40 kHz int16 mono (dBFS peak; -72 dBFS RMS seeded noise floor) -> k1_poly24 (source 40000 Hz) -> InhouseAudio analysis_rate_hz 24000, hop 180 -> tempo demand on board 1 -> product tempo_tracker.cpp / tempo_acf.cpp (unmodified); the probe's external baseline copy is asserted bit-identical (bpm, confidence) to the product tracker on every update

probe_build.compiler: host Apple clang (oracle), not the M85 binary
